text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled Terraform apply for infra/iam-cross-account today 2025-06-18 21:00 UTC. Plan requires manual approval. Window 21:00-21:15 UTC. Reply `cancel` to stop.

angela: quick question — are we pinning provider/module versions in this PR? last-minute provider bumps caused flakiness last month.

sam: yep pinning provider to `~> 5.2` and modules to fixed refs in the PR. plan output attached below. will also enable state lock (DynamoDB) and snapshot state to s3 before apply.

jordan: can we do a canary? apply to `staging-account` first, validate assume role flows for 30m, then promote to prod. if staging fails we revert.

oncall-sre: I'm oncall for the window. please add the rollback playbook link and the runbook steps in the PR checklist. I'll be watching logs and alerts.

sam: plan excerpt:
```
# aws_iam_role.redwood_cross_account will be updated in-place
~ resource "aws_iam_role" "redwood_cross_account" {
    assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
      Statement = [ { Action = "sts:AssumeRole", Principal = { AWS = "arn:aws:iam::987654321012:root" } } ]
    })
}
# aws_route53_record.gateway will be replaced
+ resource "aws_route53_record" "gateway" {
    name = "gateway.redwood.example.com"
    type = "A"
    ttl  = 60
}
```

angela: also include the exact git sha we'll revert to if things go sideways and add `terraform state pull > infra.tfstate.bak` step before apply.

sam: already added revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842 (revert commit `c3f9a2b`). pushed state snapshot step in the apply script:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-terraform-state/infra.tfstate infra.tfstate.bak && \
terraform init -input=false && \
terraform plan -out=plan.out && \
# human approval required
terraform apply "plan.out"
```

jordan: Nice. For canary: run `terraform apply -target=module.iam-staging` in the staging workspace, then promote by switching workspace and applying full plan. Leave `auto-approve` off.

oncall-sre: I'll add the monitoring checklist: smoke test endpoints, STS assume-role test, auth logs check, and confirmation of Route53 propagation. Tagging @angela and @sam for final ack. :eyes:

angela: ack from infra side. confirm provider pin looks good. :thumbsup:

sam: ack from ops. will start the staging canary at 21:00 UTC, report back at +15m and +30m. If any errors -> revert PR #842 and run revert apply.

deploy-bot: Reminder set for 20:50 UTC. Manual approval required at 21:00 UTC.

oncall-sre: logged incident channel link in PR and will be standing by. if cancelled, I'll notify infra and paging.

sam: thanks — pushing final commit now (provider pinned, revert PR linked, state snapshot added). merging at 20:55 after one more quick review. :shipit:
